description: Download and decrypt a file or voice message attached to the user's note. Text files (logs, configs, code) come back as text, photos as an image. Anything else, or any file when save_to is given, is saved to disk. block is the block number from read_note; it can be left out when the note has one file.

id.description: note id or its first characters

save_to.description: absolute path of a folder or file to save to
